cases.name: secure-boot-enabled
cases.notice: Emaki cannot start with firmware signature checking enabled (Secure Boot). Restart into your firmware settings, turn Secure Boot off, then start the USB again.

error.message: Emaki cannot start with firmware signature checking enabled (Secure Boot). Restart into your firmware settings, turn Secure Boot off, then start the USB again. No disk has been changed.

cases.name: secure-boot-unreadable
cases.notice: The firmware signature setting could not be read (Secure Boot). Restart into your firmware settings, turn Secure Boot off, then start the USB again.

cases.name: vmd-no-disk

hardware.disk_notice: No installation disk is visible behind the Intel storage controller (VMD/RST). In your firmware settings, disable VMD or Intel RST and select AHCI storage mode, then restart the USB. If another operating system is installed, prepare it for AHCI before changing this setting; otherwise it may stop booting.

cases.name: missing-live-repository
